{{short description|Polish mathematician}}
[[File:Szarek.png|thumb|Stanisław J. Szarek (2014)]]
'''Stanisław J. Szarek''' (born November 13, 1953) is a Polish professor of mathematics at both [[Case Western Reserve University]] in the USA (since 1983) and [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] in France (since 1996).<ref name="cv">[http://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~stanislaw.szarek/cvinfo.html Curriculum vitae], retrieved 2015-01-14.</ref> His research concerns [[convex geometry]] and [[functional analysis]].<ref name="langevin"/><ref name="cwru"/>

Szarek was born in [[Lądek-Zdrój]], [[Poland]].<ref name="cv"/> He earned a master's degree from the [[University of Warsaw]] in 1976, and a Ph.D. from the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] in 1979 under the supervision of [[Aleksander Pełczyński]].<ref name="cv"/><ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=44102}}</ref> He continued at the Polish Academy as a research fellow for four years before taking a faculty position at Case,<ref name="cv"/> where he is now the Kerr Professor of Mathematics.<ref name="cwru">{{citation|url=http://cwru-daily.com/news/math-faculty-elected-to-inaugural-class-of-american-mathematical-society-fellows/|title=Math faculty elected to American Mathematical Society Fellows|journal=The Daily|publisher=Case Western Reserve University|date=November 29, 2012}}.</ref>

Szarek won a gold medal in the 1971 [[International Mathematical Olympiad]].<ref name="cv"/> He was an invited speaker at the 2006 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref name="cv"/><ref name="cwru"/><ref>{{citation
 | last = Szarek | first = Stanislaw
 | contribution = Convexity, complexity, and high dimensions
 | mr = 2275661
 | pages = 1599–1621
 | publisher = Eur. Math. Soc., Zürich
 | title = International Congress of Mathematicians. Vol. II
 | year = 2006}}.</ref> In 2007 he won the Langevin Prize of the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="langevin">{{citation|url=http://www.academie-sciences.fr/activite/prix/laureat_langevin_math.pdf|publisher=[[French Academy of Sciences]]|accessdate=2015-01-14|title=PRIX LANGEVIN (en hommage à la mémoire des savants français assassinés par les Nazis en 1940-1945) (Mathématique)|language=French}}.</ref> In 2012 he became one of the inaugural [[fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]]<ref name="cwru"/><ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2015-01-14.</ref> and in 2017 he was awarded
the Sierpiński medal.<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.ptm.org.pl/konkursy/wyklady-im-waclawa-sierpinskiego|title = Medal i Wykład im. Wacława Sierpińskiego (in Polish)}}</ref>
